intro: Dog kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces built around a dog's snout ᴥ or ▼ and floppy ∪ ears. A dog kaomoji such as ໒(＾ᴥ＾)七 or U・ᴥ・U is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and usernames. Browse by mood below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "dog kaomoji" or "kaomoji dog," every pup here is free to copy and paste.
